summary: transcripts export accepts --file and -o as aliases for the explicit output path, not only --output and --vault.
reason: Agents reach for --file (and the conventional -o shorthand) to name an output path; the generated command only declared --output and --vault, so 'transcripts export <id> --file <path>' aborted with 'unknown flag: --file' before running. A regen must keep --file and -o wired to the same destination as --output.
validated_outcome: transcripts export <id> --file /tmp/out.md --agent writes the rendered markdown to the named path (verified against a real synced transcript); go build/vet/test and verify-skill all pass.
